patch.value: A registered seed cannot parent any candidate, and the tests hide it by writing outside the command surface

CodeRabbit review of pm-rl#12, Major. registerGeneration sets a seed's policy to the empty string, and every candidate's collection runs must carry component equal to the parent's policy. rl run start always sets a non-empty algorithm as the component, so EVERY candidate parented to a freshly registered seed is refused with run_policy_mismatch, and no command ever sets the seed's policy afterward.

The reviewer found why the suite is nonetheless green: the test helper giveSeedPolicy rewrites the seed body through a raw client.update, STEPPING OUTSIDE THE COMMAND SURFACE. The tests prove the internals work while the product does not - a green suite over an unusable end-to-end path.

Fix by accepting a policy for the seed registration, or by skipping the run-policy check when the parent is a seed with no recorded policy. The regression test must parent a candidate to a seed using ONLY published commands, with no raw client writes.
